diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

helm_release.karpenter lists module.karpenter in depends_on, but it already depends on module.karpenter implicitly through references to module.karpenter.service_account and module.karpenter.queue_name in its values. The explicit depends_on entry is redundant.

null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class lists module.eks in depends_on, but its triggers already reference module.eks.cluster_primary_security_group_id and module.eks.cluster_security_group_id, so Terraform already orders it after module.eks. The explicit depends_on entry is redundant.

null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class lists module.karpenter (and module.karpenter.node_iam_role_arn) in depends_on, but its triggers.role_arn already references module.karpenter.node_iam_role_arn, so the ordering is already implied. The explicit depends_on entry is redundant.

null_resource.update_kubeconfig lists module.eks in depends_on, but its local-exec command already references module.eks.cluster_name (for --name and --alias), which establishes the same dependency implicitly. The explicit depends_on entry is redundant.

null_resource.delete_daemonset deletes the aws-node (VPC CNI) daemonset, but it only depends on module.eks and null_resource.update_kubeconfig. It must be ordered after null_resource.create_calico_installation so the Calico CNI Installation exists before the previous CNI is torn down; otherwise nodes are left with no working network plugin and pods scheduled by later steps (Karpenter, node pools) will fail. No attribute of a null_resource gives a clean data reference, so an explicit depends_on = [null_resource.create_calico_installation] is the appropriate fix.
